visual_medium.description: 2D digital vector cartoon animation and architectural infographic diagrams. Features thick black outlines, flat solid colors with minimal cel-shading, and simplified educational comic book character designs with round white heads and expressive eyes.

palette.grade_notes: High contrast between freezing icy blues/whites and glowing hearth fire orange/amber tones.

lighting.direction_pattern: ambient front with local radial fire glows
lighting.notes: Flat diagrammatic lighting supplemented with stylized radial warmth waves around heat sources.

on_screen_text.titles_or_labels: bold uppercase infographic text boxes, labeled cutaway diagrams, temperature indicators, and airflow arrows
on_screen_text.diagram_style: comic-style architectural section views with labelled callout lines and red/blue convective flow paths

subjects.people: Stick-proportioned cartoon Norse Vikings with brown beards and horned helmets alongside modern stick figures.
subjects.scale_cues: Human stick figures placed next to walls, trenches, and beds for structural proportion.

audio.narration_voice: male, mid-30s, energetic North American accent, articulate educational pacing
audio.music: present, upbeat electronic acoustic explainer background track, moderate low volume
audio.sfx: present, wind whistling, fire crackling, whoosh sound effects, stone scraping

structure.hook_description: A cartoon man shivers violently in a sub-zero blizzard before entering an ancient cozy longhouse at 20°C.
structure.cta_visuals: Animated cartoon host beside a fireplace with subscribe, bell, and like button graphics.

prompt_prefix: Clean 2D vector educational cartoon illustration, bold crisp black outlines, flat colors, subtle cel shading, architectural infographic diagram elements, vibrant dual-temperature palette of cool ice blues and warm hearth ambers, wide clear framing, deep focus.
negative_prompt: photorealistic, 3d render, realistic textures, grainy photo, messy sketches, blurry line art, film grain, complex gradients
